checks.name: ESG 표기 공모펀드
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master WHERE itm_nm ILIKE '%ESG%' OR itm_abrv_nm ILIKE '%ESG%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN replace(trim(coalesce(sale_yn,'')), ' ', '')='판매중' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, itm_no LIMIT 20

checks.name: TDF2045 표기 공모펀드
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master WHERE itm_nm ILIKE '%TDF2045%' OR itm_abrv_nm ILIKE '%TDF2045%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN replace(trim(coalesce(sale_yn,'')), ' ', '')='판매중' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, itm_no LIMIT 20

checks.name: 미래에셋 표기 공모펀드 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fund_master WHERE itm_nm ILIKE '%미래에셋%' OR itm_abrv_nm ILIKE '%미래에셋%'

checks.name: 위험등급 6등급 공모펀드 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fund_master WHERE TRY_CAST(drv_risk_grade AS INT)=6

checks.name: 국내 주식형 1년 수익률 상위
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master WHERE TRY_CAST(fd_yr1_ern_r AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(fd_yr1_ern_r AS DOUBLE)<>0 AND zrin_btyp_nm ILIKE '%주식형%' AND ovrs_fd_desc='국내' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(fd_yr1_ern_r AS DOUBLE) DESC, itm_no LIMIT 5

checks.name: BBB 회사채
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='회사채' AND drv_maturity_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT)=9 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT), TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, PD_NO LIMIT 20

checks.name: 2030년 이후 국공채 표면금리 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='국공채' AND MAT_DT >= '2030-01-01' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, PD_NO LIMIT 3

checks.name: 삼성전자 편입 ETF(비중 순)
checks.sql: SELECT e.pd_abrv_nm, e.pd_nm FROM etf_constituent c LEFT JOIN kr_etp e ON c.etf_isin=e.pd_itm_no WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='005930' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(replace(c.COMPST_RTO, ',', '') AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, c.etf_isin LIMIT 30

checks.name: 삼성전자 편입 ETF(비중 순)
checks.sql: SELECT e.pd_abrv_nm, e.pd_nm FROM etf_constituent c LEFT JOIN kr_etp e ON c.etf_isin=e.pd_itm_no WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='005930' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(replace(c.COMPST_RTO, ',', '') AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, c.etf_isin LIMIT 30

checks.name: SK하이닉스 편입 ETF 순자산 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT e.pd_abrv_nm, e.pd_nm FROM etf_constituent c LEFT JOIN kr_etp e ON c.etf_isin=e.pd_itm_no WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='000660' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, c.etf_isin LIMIT 3

checks.name: 유럽 표기 ETF 순자산 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND pd_nm ILIKE '%유럽%' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 미국+국채/미국채 표기 ETF 순자산 상위 5(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (pd_nm ILIKE '%미국%국채%' OR pd_nm ILIKE '%미국채%') ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 5

checks.name: 중국/차이나+전기차 순자산 1위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (pd_nm ILIKE '%중국%전기차%' OR pd_nm ILIKE '%차이나%전기차%') ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 1

checks.name: iShares 표기(운용사 또는 상품명) 해외 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM global_etf WHERE pd_nm ILIKE '%ishares%' OR cu_fund_mgmt_co ILIKE '%ishares%'

checks.name: TIGER 상장중 ETF 총보수 단순 평균
checks.sql: SELECT round(avg(TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE)),2) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_listing_status='active' AND drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND pd_nm ILIKE '%TIGER%' AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE),0)<>0

checks.name: 만기 미도래 국공채 표면금리 단순 평균
checks.sql: SELECT round(avg(TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE)),2) FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='국공채' AND drv_maturity_status='active' AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE),0)<>0

checks.name: 해외 ETF(ETN 제외) 총보수 단순 평균
checks.sql: SELECT round(avg(TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE)),2) FROM global_etf WHERE coalesce(TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE),0)>0 AND upper(coalesce(drv_is_etn,'')) NOT IN ('Y','TRUE','1')

checks.name: AA 이상 회사채 세후수익률 단순 평균
checks.sql: SELECT round(avg(TRY_CAST(AFTER_TAX_YIELD AS DOUBLE)),2) FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='회사채' AND drv_maturity_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT)<=3 AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(AFTER_TAX_YIELD AS DOUBLE),0)<>0

checks.name: 미국+반도체 순자산 1위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND pd_nm ILIKE '%미국%반도체%' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 1
